sources: oldschool.runescape.wiki strategy pages (presets, recommended stats, inventories)
wvanderp/osrs-db (MIT, item stats + equip requirements → generated into gear.json)
meta.notes: Presets are hand-curated starting points, not DPS-calculator output. Item stats, equip requirements and prices come from gear.json, generated by tools/build-gear.ts — rerun it whenever preset item lists change.

bosses.name: Fight Caves
bosses.tagline: TzHaar's 63-wave endurance run — the fire cape rite of passage.
bosses.location: TzHaar city, under the Karamja volcano (no quest needed to enter)

skills.note: Protect from Magic/Ranged — non-negotiable for Jad

recommended.note: 61 is possible with patience; higher = faster waves
Below ~65 the wave 60–62 bats and mages hit hard
More HP = more room for prayer-switch mistakes

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: First-attempt gear — everything buyable for well under 100k. Dragon Slayer I covers the black d'hide body.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: The whole run is prayer-gated — never run dry

inventory.name: Emergency teleport
inventory.note: Ring of dueling in the ring slot doubles as this

presets.notes: Broad bolts are the classic cheap ammo (55 Slayer to equip — check yours). Adamant bolts hit the same +100 ranged strength without the Slayer gate. Swap to Ruby bolts (e) for Jad's 250 HP.

presets.name: Comfortable
presets.description: ~15–20m of upgrades: the crossbow and necklace carry the run. Karil's needs 70 Defence; Barrows gloves need Recipe for Disaster.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Faster kills = fewer waves per sip

inventory.name: Saradomin brew(4)
inventory.note: Jad panic-button heals

inventory.name: Super restore(4)
inventory.note: Restores what the brews drain

presets.notes: Dragon bolts can only be fired from a rune/dragon/Armadyl crossbow. Barrows gloves need full Recipe for Disaster — black d'hide vambraces are the stand-in until then.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: Pre-raid best-in-slot. Ava's assembler needs Dragon Slayer II to make; everything else is GE-buyable.
presets.notes: A Toxic blowpipe (75 Ranged) clears waves faster than a crossbow, but most players still kill Jad with bolts. Imbue the archers ring at Nightmare Zone for +50% effect. The true endgame item is the Twisted bow — a raid drop.

bosses.notes: Tag the three healers off Jad before finishing him, and prayer-switch on his animation: legs curling = ranged, head rearing = magic. Death is safe (items kept) — the only real cost is the hour.

bosses.name: Giant Mole
bosses.tagline: Falador Park's overgrown rodent — the classic first boss.
bosses.location: Mole Lair, under Falador Park (bring a spade and a light source)

recommended.note: She's crush-resistant — bring your best non-crush weapon
Protect from Melee makes her harmless

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: A plain obsidian melee set — often already on mid-game accounts. The berserker necklace multiplies obsidian-weapon damage.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Only needed if praying

inventory.name: Super combat potion(4)
inventory.note: Or Attack/Strength potions

inventory.name: Spade
inventory.note: To enter the lair

inventory.name: Light source
inventory.note: Candle, lantern or Firemaking cape — the lair is pitch dark

presets.notes: The mole digs away at random — watch the dirt direction, or turn RuneLite's mole locator on. Stamina potions help between digs.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: The whip upgrade path. Helm of Neitiznot needs The Fremennik Isles; Barrows gloves need Recipe for Disaster; Fighter torso is Barbarian Assault rewarded.
presets.notes: Fighter torso (free, from Barbarian Assault) is nearly as good as Bandos. Primordial boots edge out dragon boots if you're rich. Imbue the berserker ring for the real upgrade.

bosses.notes: Baby mole ticks damage in the last phase — step away or ignore them. Mole skins/claws trade for bird nests and tree seeds at Wyson.

bosses.name: Barrows
bosses.tagline: Six crypt brothers, one chest — the original gear minigame.
bosses.location: Morytania, south-east of Canifis

recommended.note: Iban's Blast shreds the melee brothers through their armour
Each brother prays against one style — overheads cover their attacks
Ahrim and Karil hit through gaps in melee armour

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: Iban's Blast + mystic. Underground Pass unlocks the staff; until then a fire bolt setup (or your melee gear) works at half speed.

inventory.name: Iban blast runes
inventory.note: Death + fire runes — the staff holds the charges (see the wiki for exact costs)

inventory.name: Spade
inventory.note: To open the crypts

inventory.name: Teleport out
inventory.note: Ring of dueling (worn) teleports to clan wars to reset

presets.notes: Kill Dharok first with Protect from Melee on — he's the one-shot machine. Ahrim (magic) and Karil (ranged) need their matching prayers switched on quickly.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: The upgraded staff holds 2,500 casts. Trident of the Seas (75 Magic) beats Iban's if you have the levels and Zulrah scales.
presets.notes: Morytania legs 3 (In Aid of the Myreque reward) give unlimited Burgh de Rott teleports — a short run from Barrows. Huge for trip speed.

bosses.notes: The reward roll scales with kill count and potential — always loot the chest after all six brothers. Unwanted sets are a steady prayer-experience income.

bosses.name: Obor
bosses.tagline: Hill giant champion of the Edgeville sewers — F2P's first real boss.
bosses.location: Obor's lair, Edgeville Dungeon (giant key required — hill giant drop)

recommended.note: With 40 Prayer, Protect from Missiles blanks his ranged slams

presets.name: F2P melee
presets.description: Full rune — the platebody needs Dragon Slayer I. Cheap, effective, and every F2P account ends up here.

inventory.name: Giant key
inventory.note: One per kill — hill giants drop them

presets.notes: His ranged shock hits through melee armour — 40+ Prayer keeps it off you entirely (Protect from Missiles).

presets.name: Members melee
presets.description: The same obsidian set that carries Giant Mole. Bring a couple of binding spells for fewer chases.
presets.notes: Entangle or Ice Rush keeps him still — members' convenience.

bosses.notes: His slam attack can be avoided by staying out of melee range for a beat — watch for the animation.

bosses.name: Bryophyta
bosses.tagline: The moss giant matriarch — Obor's ranged-friendly cousin in Varrock sewers.
bosses.location: Bryophyta's lair, Varrock Sewers (mossy key required — moss giant drop)

recommended.note: Wiki strategy: ranging her is the mid-level F2P play
Protect from Magic before you open the gate

presets.name: F2P ranged
presets.description: Green d'hide and a maple shortbow. A rune scimitar melee setup works too if your melee is higher.

inventory.name: Mossy key
inventory.note: One per kill — moss giants drop them

presets.notes: Below ~75% HP she may summon three growthlings — kill them with an axe or secateurs (magic secateurs work) to resume damaging her. Protection prayers are fully effective here; keep Protect from Magic up.

bosses.notes: Growthling melee damage still lands while you pray Magic — bring food, not just prayer potions.

bosses.name: Sarachnis
bosses.tagline: The spider queen of Forthos Dungeon — mid-game melee training with real drops.
bosses.location: Forthos Dungeon, south-west of Hosidius (no requirements)

recommended.note: Her melee and ranged hits bounce off 70+ defence
Tank the melee spawn, pray against the magic one

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip-and-defender mid-game gear. Your obsidian set from Giant Mole works while you build toward this.

inventory.name: Antivenom+(4)
inventory.note: Spiderling spawns poison

presets.notes: Fighter torso + obsidian platelegs is the budget stand-in. She webs the floor — stamp the web tiles to free yourself.

bosses.notes: Egg spawns hatch spiderlings — clear them or they stack poison damage. Instanced and non-instanced versions both exist.

bosses.name: Zulrah
bosses.tagline: The serpent of Zulrah — magic/ranged rotations, the mid-game wall every account climbs.
bosses.location: Zul-Andra, east of Tyras (charter ship or Zul-Andra teleport — no quest needed)

recommended.note: Trident territory; 80+ makes the rotations comfortable
Blowpipe for the ranged rotations
Her magic is more accurate than her ranged — plan prayer accordingly
Protect from Magic through most rotations

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The Seers ring you already own slots right in until you can afford a Magus ring.

inventory.name: Runes / scales
inventory.note: Trident charges: 1 chaos + 5 fire + 10 water per cast

inventory.name: Antivenom+(4)
inventory.note: Snakeling poison stacks

presets.notes: An imbued god cape (Mage Arena II) upgrades the cape slot. Most learners die to the Jad phase — switch prayers on her head bob, not the hit.

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Blowpipe + Karil's for the blue (ranged) rotations; most killers still bring a magic switch.

inventory.name: Scales + darts
inventory.note: Blowpipe burns ~2 scales per 3 shots (Zulrah drops both)

presets.notes: Realistically Zulrah is a two-style fight — treat this as the ranged half of a switch setup.

bosses.notes: Learn the four standard rotations (there are good cheat-sheet images on the wiki). Deaths are cheap; the 100-kill learning curve is the real cost.

bosses.name: Dagannoth Kings
bosses.tagline: Rex, Prime and Supreme under Waterbirth Island — the ring-drop trio.
bosses.location: Waterbirth Island Dungeon (boat from Rellekka)

recommended.note: Supreme (melee-vulnerable) wants a whip
Rex is the magic target — 75 for a trident
Prime falls to a crossbow
Each king attacks one style — overheads make you nearly immune

presets.name: Rex · Magic
presets.description: Solo-Rex: lure him around the rocks and blast. Iban's staff (Underground Pass) is the budget stand-in; fire bolt + chaos gauntlets works before that.

inventory.name: Trident charges / runes
inventory.note: Or Iban blast runes: 1 fire + 2 death per cast

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Protect from Magic vs Rex's nothing — it's for the dungeon

presets.notes: Rex only melees and can't reach you behind the rocks — the classic first-soloable-king. Chaos gauntlets (Family Crest) boost fire bolt while you work toward a trident.

presets.name: Prime · Ranged
presets.description: Crossbow + d'hide, praying Magic the whole time. Ruby bolts (e) punch through his HP.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Prime hits constant magic

presets.notes: Prime wanders — tag him and drag him to a safe corner before settling in.

presets.name: Supreme · Melee
presets.description: Whip + defender, praying Ranged. The most straightforward of the three for a melee main.
presets.notes: Supreme's ranged attack is the only thing that hurts while you pray — kill the spinolyps between respawns for peace.

bosses.notes: The Fremennik Trials gate is soft: the Rellekka guards let you in once you've STARTED the quest, which is when the boat becomes usable. Kings respawn quickly — most learners start with solo Rex. Watch the 81-Agility crevice shortcut for faster trips.

bosses.name: Vorkath
bosses.tagline: The blue dragon of Ungael — OSRS's most consistent money-maker.
bosses.location: Ungael, reachable after Dragon Slayer II

recommended.note: Or 80 Magic — pick one style and commit to it
Dragonfire is the real threat, not the melee
Protect from Magic through the fight

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Dragon hunter crossbow + dragon bolts is the Vorkath meta. A rune crossbow with dragon bolts is the budget stand-in until you can afford the DHCB.

inventory.name: Super antifire potion(4)
inventory.note: Non-negotiable — his dragonfire is the fight

inventory.name: Ruby → diamond bolt swap
inventory.note: Ruby (e) for the first ~65%, Diamond dragon bolts (e) after

inventory.name: Antivenom+ / antidote++
inventory.note: His ranged spit venoms

presets.notes: The Dragonfire shield needs Dragon Slayer I and 75 Defence; an Anti-dragon shield (Dragon Slayer I) works at any Defence while you build toward it. Dodge the acid pools in his last phase.

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The occult and seers ring you already own slot right in.
presets.notes: The imbued god cape is a Mage Arena II reward — the plain god cape (Mage Arena I) is the stand-in.

bosses.notes: His 'blue fireball' special is a line-of-sight dodge — step sideways, don't tank it. Count his attacks to predict the acid pool phase.

bosses.name: Phantom Muspah
bosses.tagline: The frozen phantom — mechanics-heavy money-maker.
bosses.location: Muspah's lair, reachable after Secrets of the North

recommended.note: Trident territory; 75 is the floor
His ranged phase hits through prayer gaps
Switch overheads with his attack style

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's through both phases. The occult and seers ring you already own slot straight in.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: His smite phase drains prayer hard

inventory.name: Stamina potion(4)
inventory.note: He teleports across the lair constantly

presets.notes: He's only 33% susceptible to freezes — keep him in the north-west corner with a step-under lure instead of relying on freeze.

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Blowpipe for the walk phases. Most killers run a magic switch — treat this as the ranged half.
presets.notes: Prayer switch is the whole fight — ranged phase hits through Protect from Magic and vice versa. Watch for the smite attack's prayer-drain debuff.

bosses.notes: His freeze resistance means 33% reduced freeze duration — don't plan around full freezes. Bring a spade? No — that's for Barrows. Venom is the main chip damage.

bosses.name: God Wars Dungeon
bosses.tagline: The four generals — Bandos, Armadyl, Saradomin, Zamorak.
bosses.location: Trollheim, north-west of Burthorpe (40 kill count per boss)

recommended.note: Graardor tanking wants 80+ melee
The generals hit through prayer gaps
Kree'arra's ranged team
One overhead per general's style

presets.name: General Graardor · Melee
presets.description: The classic team boss. Bandos' Stronghold door needs 70 Strength and a hammer.

inventory.name: Hammer
inventory.note: Opens Bandos' Stronghold door

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Trips live and die on prayer

presets.notes: 40 kill count (20 with an ecumenical key from Wilderness bosses) before the door opens. Tank prays Melee, teammates Ranged. Godsword shards are the chase drop.

presets.name: Kree'arra · Ranged
presets.description: Armadyl's Eyrie needs 70 Ranged and a mith grapple to cross the chasm.

inventory.name: Mith grapple
inventory.note: Crosses the chasm to Armadyl's Eyrie

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Protect from Ranged against Kree'arra

presets.notes: 40 kill count (or ecumenical key). Armadyl crossbow and dragon bolts are the ranged meta here; a rune crossbow with diamond bolts (e) works on a budget.

bosses.notes: Commander Zilyana's chamber needs 70 Agility (unboostable) + two ropes on the first visit; K'ril Tsutsaroth's needs no extra level. Zamorakian/Saradominist kill count opens those doors. Teams split the four generals for their godsword hilts.

bosses.name: King Black Dragon
bosses.tagline: The classic dragon — everyone's first real dragon boss.
bosses.location: KBD Lair, deep Wilderness (use the Lava Maze entry for a safespot)

recommended.note: Or 70 Ranged — pick a style
Dragonfire is the only real danger
Protect from Melee blanks his claw attacks

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip + dragonfire shield. The shield needs Dragon Slayer I and 75 Defence; an Anti-dragon shield works before that.

inventory.name: Super antifire potion(4)
inventory.note: Stacks with the shield for full dragonfire protection

presets.notes: Wilderness boss — be ready to teleport out at 30 Wilderness if a PKer shows. The Lava Maze entrance gives a safe ladder to hop.

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Crossbow + dragonfire shield from a distance.
presets.notes: His firebreath hits magic defence — d'hide's high magic defence is why ranged is the safe pick.

bosses.notes: Dragon pickaxe and pet are the chase drops. Safespot him behind the ladder by the Lava Maze entrance if soloing low-level.

bosses.name: Kalphite Queen
bosses.tagline: Two phases, two prayer styles — the queen of the Kalphite Lair.
bosses.location: Kalphite Lair, west of the Shantay Pass (bring two ropes)

recommended.note: Crush is her weakness in phase two
Her attacks are 100% accurate — prayer is mandatory
Protect from Magic phase 1, Protect from Missiles phase 2

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Crush weapons hit hardest in phase two. A Dragon mace is the budget crush pick.

inventory.name: Ropes
inventory.note: First time down the lair only

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Two phases of overheads

presets.notes: Phase two drops prayer protection — swap to Protect from Missiles the moment she swaps styles. A Dragon mace or Zamorakian spear (crush) out-hits the whip here.

bosses.notes: Drops the Dragon chainbody and dragon 2h sword pieces. Bring a ranged/magic switch for the first phase's workers if soloing.

bosses.name: Scurrius
bosses.tagline: The giant rat of the Varrock Sewers — the modern combat trainer.
bosses.location: Varrock Sewers

recommended.note: Any style works — bone weapons are his drops
Protect from Melee stops the rat swarm

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Full rune or better. His Bone mace drops make him the best low-mid combat XP in the game.
presets.notes: Kill the rat spawns before they swarm you — Scurrius heals while they're alive. Bone weaponry (mace/shortbow/staff) shreds him.

bosses.notes: The Bone mace/shortbow/staff he drops are BiS against him — swap them in as you get them. This is the fastest early combat XP.

bosses.name: Corporeal Beast
bosses.tagline: The 2,000 HP spirit shield machine — a true group boss.
bosses.location: Corporeal Beast Lair, deep Wilderness (no quest needed)

recommended.note: Only spears and hastas can damage him
He hits through prayer constantly
Protect from Magic reduces, never removes, the damage

presets.name: Melee (spear)
presets.description: Zamorakian spear is the weapon — anything else hits for nearly nothing.

inventory.name: Monkfish / sharks
inventory.note: He's a damage sponge

presets.notes: The spear isn't optional — it's the only weapon type that bypasses his defence. Groups of 4+ with one spec-teleporter (Dragon warhammer) make it manageable.

bosses.notes: Spirit shields (elysian sigil) are the jackpot. Solo him by standing under to dodge the core. You must use a spear or hasta to deal meaningful damage.

bosses.name: Kraken
bosses.tagline: The Cave Kraken boss — AFK magic money.
bosses.location: Kraken Cove (Kraken Slayer task required)

skills.note: Cannot be boosted — need an active Kraken task too

recommended.note: Trident territory — 87 is ideal
Protect from Magic

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + mystic/Ahrim's. The occult and seers ring you already own slot straight in.

inventory.name: Monkfish / sharks
inventory.note: The tentacles hurt if you let them stack

presets.notes: The four tentacles heal it — either ignore them with high defence or kill the whirlpools. It's a very AFK-friendly boss once set up.

bosses.notes: Drops the Kraken tentacle (barbarian fishing XP) and the Trident of the Seas itself. Gated by 87 Slayer, so it's a long-term goal — but nearly zero-risk money.

bosses.name: Grotesque Guardians
bosses.tagline: Dusk and Dawn — the gargoyle duo atop the Slayer Tower.
bosses.location: Slayer Tower rooftop (gargoyle Slayer task + brittle key to first enter)

skills.note: Gargoyle task + a brittle key from gargoyle kills

recommended.note: Whip territory
Dawn's flying phase
Protect from Melee on Dusk, Missiles on Dawn

presets.name: Melee + ranged switch
presets.description: Whip for Dusk (ground), crossbow for Dawn's flying phase.

inventory.name: Rune crossbow + bolts
inventory.note: Switch for Dawn's flight

presets.notes: Two bosses, two overheads — Melee on Dusk, Ranged on Dawn. Don't stand in the purple lightning. The brittle key is a one-time unlock.

bosses.notes: Drops the granite dust and the gargoyle pet. Dusk is weak to melee, Dawn to ranged — the switch is the whole fight.

bosses.name: Chaos Fanatic
bosses.tagline: The lava-wreathed mage — Wildy demi-boss with pet potential.
bosses.location: West of the Lava Maze, level 42 Wilderness

recommended.note: Or 70 Magic — he's squishy either way
Protect from Magic

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Mystic + trident. His magic attack is the thing to pray against.
presets.notes: Wilderness boss — keep a one-click teleport ready and stay mobile. He spawns a chaos elemental helper.

bosses.notes: Drops the Chaos pet and shards for the Odium/Malediction wards. Easy to camp, PKers are the real boss.

bosses.name: Crazy Archaeologist
bosses.tagline: The mad mage of the Ruins — Wildy demi-boss.
bosses.location: Ruins (west), level 25 Wilderness

recommended.note: Crossbow + bolts
Protect from Magic against his blasts

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Crossbow + d'hide from out of his book-blast range.
presets.notes: His special hurls three books in a spread — step out of the tiles. Level 25 Wildy, so teleport works unless you're teleblocked.

bosses.notes: Drops the Odium shard 2 and the fedora. A quick, low-risk Wildy kill.

bosses.name: Scorpia
bosses.tagline: The giant scorpion — Wildy demi-boss.
bosses.location: Scorpion Pit, level 53 Wilderness (deep — bring a teleport)

recommended.note: Her melee hits hard through prayer
Protect from Magic against the scorpion spawns

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Mystic + trident. Hug the wall so the scorpion spawns can't stack.
presets.notes: Level 53 Wildy — PKers will find you. She spawns two scorpion guardians that range you; hugging the wall minimises them.

bosses.notes: Drops the Malediction shard 3 and the Scorpia's offspring pet.

bosses.name: Callisto
bosses.tagline: The bear of the Frozen Waste — Wildy boss with the Tyrannical ring.
bosses.location: Callisto's Den, level 45 Wilderness

recommended.note: Or melee — he hits hard either way
Protect from Magic stops his roar

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Crossbow + d'hide. His roar is a magic attack — pray Magic.
presets.notes: His roar knocks you back and drains prayer — step behind him to avoid it. The singles variant Calvar'ion has the same loot table in a safer arena.

bosses.notes: Drops the Tyrannical ring and dragon pickaxe. Deep-ish Wildy — the singles variants (Calvar'ion) are the safer grind.

bosses.name: Venenatis
bosses.tagline: The spider queen of the Wildy — drops the Treasonous ring.
bosses.location: Spider's Den, level 44 Wilderness

recommended.note: Protect from Magic

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip + defender. Stand under her to force her into melee range.
presets.notes: Her magic webs drag you in — stand under her to stop the ranged/magic cycle. The singles variant Spindel shares the drop table.

bosses.notes: Drops the Treasonous ring and dragon pickaxe.

bosses.name: Vet'ion
bosses.tagline: The skeletal undead — Salve amulet melts him.
bosses.location: Vet'ion's Rest, level 40 Wilderness

recommended.note: Protect from Melee

presets.name: Melee (salve)
presets.description: Vet'ion is undead — a Salve amulet (e) gives a big damage boost over any other neck slot.

inventory.name: Salve amulet (e)
inventory.note: BiS here — undead bonus beats any fury

presets.notes: Vet'ion summons two hellhound guardians — kill them first or they'll drain your supplies. Calvar'ion is the singles version with the same loot.

bosses.notes: Drops the Ring of the gods and dragon pickaxe. Salve amulet (e) is the single biggest upgrade for this fight.

bosses.name: Abyssal Sire
bosses.tagline: The abyssal demon king — the Sire of the Slayer ladder.
bosses.location: Sire's lair, reached through the Abyss (85 Slayer + one Abyss visit)

skills.note: Abyssal demon task; visit the Abyss once first

recommended.note: Melee the main body after the tentacles
Protect from Melee on the final phase

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Arclight (Shadow of the Storm) is BiS against demons — the whip works while you unlock it.

inventory.name: Rune crossbow + bolts
inventory.note: Kill the four respiratory systems first

presets.notes: The fight is four respiratory systems, then the Sire itself — pray Melee once the body wakes. Arclight (ancient shards) makes the last phase much faster.

bosses.notes: Drops the Unsired → bludgeon pieces and the abyssal orphan pet.

bosses.name: Cerberus
bosses.tagline: The three-headed hellhound — spectral shield territory.
bosses.location: Cerberus' Lair, Taverley Dungeon (91 Slayer + hellhound task)

skills.note: Hellhound task (wild pies can boost the level)

recommended.note: Whip or better
The three ghost attacks drain 66% of your prayer each

presets.name: Melee + spectral
presets.description: A Spectral spirit shield halves the ghost prayer-drain — the single best defensive upgrade for this fight.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: The ghosts eat your prayer

presets.notes: Three ghost attacks: A (Melee prayer), B (Ranged prayer), C (Magic prayer) — the wrong overhead means 66% prayer gone. Spectral halves it.

bosses.notes: Drops the primordial, pegasian and eternal crystals (the boot upgrades). 91 Slayer is the real gate.

bosses.name: Thermonuclear Smoke Devil
bosses.tagline: Thermy — the magic-vulnerable smoke devil boss.
bosses.location: Smoke Devil Dungeon, south of Castle Wars (93 Slayer + task)

recommended.note: Trident melts him
Protect from Magic

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The occult and seers ring you already own slot straight in.
presets.notes: Stand just out of melee range and it can't reach you — it only attacks with magic. Pure trident DPS from there.

bosses.notes: Drops the Occult necklace and smoke battlestaff. Very AFK once you're in position.

bosses.name: Alchemical Hydra
bosses.tagline: The Karuulm experiment — lance territory at 95 Slayer.
bosses.location: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, Mount Karuulm (95 Slayer + hydra task)

recommended.note: Dragon hunter lance is the meta
Protect from Magic/Melee as it swaps

presets.name: Melee (lance)
presets.description: The Dragon hunter lance is purpose-built for draconic bosses — whip/hasta work on a budget.
presets.notes: Skip the flame phase by standing on the vents in the corners. Dodge the lightning tiles in phase two. The lance makes this the best consistent Slayer money.

bosses.notes: Drops the Hydra's claw (→ Dragon hunter lance) and leather. 95 Slayer is the long grind.

bosses.name: Hespori
bosses.tagline: The Farming Guild's house boss — plant a seed, fight a flower.
bosses.location: Farming Guild, west wing (65 Farming + Hespori seed)

skills.note: Plant a hespori seed in the patch to spawn it

recommended.note: Melee works fine
Protect from Melee

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip + defender. She's tanky but predictable.
presets.notes: She periodically spawns flowers that heal her — chop or kill them fast. It's a Farming boss, so treat it as a daily-ish profit rather than a camp.

bosses.notes: Drops the bottomless compost bucket and seeds. The hespori seed comes from your own farming patches.

bosses.name: The Nightmare
bosses.tagline: Slepe's dream boss — crush her with a team.
bosses.location: Sisterhood Sanctuary, under Slepe (Morytania access)

recommended.note: Crush is her weakness
Overheads through the parasite phases

presets.name: Melee (crush)
presets.description: The Abyssal bludgeon's crush is ideal — a Zamorakian spear or whip works on a budget.
presets.notes: Team boss — the parasite phases (grasping claws) and the pillar phase are the mechanics to learn. Phosani's Nightmare is the brutal solo hard mode.

bosses.notes: Drops the Inquisitor's armour and Nightmare staff pieces. Morytania access (Priest in Peril) is the only hard gate.

bosses.name: Vardorvis
bosses.tagline: The strangled guardian of the Stranglewood — melee with fast specials.
bosses.location: The Stranglewood (Desert Treasure II)

recommended.note: Melee is the meta
Protect from Melee

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip or better. His vine-and-head specials are the fight, not his raw damage.
presets.notes: Dodge the axe-head projectiles he flings and the roots that pin you — step back when he telegraphs them. Fast reactions beat raw gear here.

bosses.notes: Drops the Ultor vestige (the melee BiS ring piece). Desert Treasure II is the long gate.

bosses.name: Duke Sucellus
bosses.tagline: The chthonian duke — crush him before the ice thaws.
bosses.location: Ghorrock Prison (Desert Treasure II)

recommended.note: Crush is his weakness
Protect from Magic against the ice barrage

presets.name: Melee (crush)
presets.description: The Abyssal bludgeon's crush is ideal — a Zamorakian spear works too.
presets.notes: He starts frozen — hit him with crush while he can't fight back, then reset when he thaws and barrages. Crush weapons out-DPS everything else here.

bosses.notes: Drops the Magus vestige. The 'use crush while frozen' loop is the whole rhythm.

bosses.name: The Leviathan
bosses.tagline: The lightning leviathan — ranged through the shadow pools.
bosses.location: The Scar (Desert Treasure II)

recommended.note: Blowpipe territory
Protect from Ranged

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Blowpipe + Karil's. Speed is the whole fight — the pools punish slow feet.
presets.notes: Stay out of the dark pools that spread across the arena — they hit through everything. Keep moving and keep firing.

bosses.notes: Drops the Venator vestige. One of the fastest DT2 kills once the movement clicks.

bosses.name: The Whisperer
bosses.tagline: The siren of Lassar — magic and prayer flicking.
bosses.location: Lassar Undercity (Desert Treasure II)

recommended.note: Trident territory
Flick between her magic and ranged

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The occult and seers ring you already own slot straight in.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Flicking burns prayer

presets.notes: She alternates magic and ranged with a tell — flick the matching overhead. Her shadow-clone phase needs you to hit the right one.

bosses.notes: Drops the Bellator vestige. The prayer-flick is the learning curve; magic DPS is straightforward.

bosses.name: Nex
bosses.tagline: The fifth general — a 60-player God Wars team boss.
bosses.location: Ancient Prison, God Wars Dungeon (frozen key to enter)

recommended.note: Crossbow is the meta
Overheads per phase

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Armadyl crossbow + dragon bolts. Teams split styles; ranged is the reliable pick.

inventory.name: Diamond dragon bolts (e)
inventory.note: Swap from ruby in the last phase

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Long team fights

inventory.name: Saradomin brew(4)
inventory.note: Her specials hurt

inventory.name: Super restore(4)
inventory.note: Restores what the brews drain

presets.notes: The frozen key is assembled from four God Wars minion pieces. Four phases with different prayers — teams call the switches. Mass worlds (dozens of players) are the learner path.

bosses.notes: Drops the Zaryte crossbow, Torva armour and the Nexling pet. The 70s-in-four-skills gate is the entry ticket.

bosses.name: Chaos Elemental
bosses.tagline: The Wildy's oldest boss — d2h nostalgia.
bosses.location: West of the Rogue's Castle, level 50 Wilderness

recommended.note: Or 60 Ranged — he's squishy
Protect from Magic

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip or obby melee. His teleport attack is the only mechanic.
presets.notes: Level 50 Wilderness — one-click teleport ready. He teleports you around the area and unequips your items occasionally.

bosses.notes: Drops the dragon 2h sword and the Chaos Elemental pet. PKers are the real fight.

bosses.name: Skotizo
bosses.tagline: The dark demon of the Catacombs — one dark totem per fight.
bosses.location: Catacombs of Kourend (dark totem to enter)

recommended.note: Arclight is BiS against demons
Protect from Melee

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Arclight (ancient shards) shreds him — the whip works while you build it.

inventory.name: Dark totem
inventory.note: One attempt — assembled from Catacombs slayer drops

presets.notes: Hit the four glowing dark altars to stop him healing — Arclight's demon bonus makes this quick. Sporadic: you fight him when you have a totem.

bosses.notes: Drops the Skotizo pet and guaranteed elite clue scrolls. Ancient shards (for Arclight) are his real value.

bosses.name: Inferno
bosses.tagline: TzKal-Zuk and 68 waves — the hardest solo PvM in the game.
bosses.location: TzHaar city, Karamja (the Inferno)

recommended.note: Crossbow or Twisted bow
Higher prayer + Rigour makes the triple-Jad waves far kinder

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: The Twisted bow is the meta — an Armadyl crossbow with dragon bolts is the entry setup. This is a marathon, not a boss.

inventory.name: Saradomin brew(4)
inventory.note: A wave-fight, not a kill

inventory.name: Super restore(4)
inventory.note: Restores the brews' drain

inventory.name: Emergency teleport
inventory.note: Death is a safe-reward wipe — be ready to bail

presets.notes: 68 waves, then triple Jads, then Zuk. The shield is the point — this is a 1.5–3h execution test, not a gear check.

bosses.notes: The Infernal cape is the BiS melee cape. Learning wave safespots matters more than any single item.

bosses.name: Chambers of Xeric
bosses.tagline: Raids 1 — team up for Olm in Mount Quidamortem.
bosses.location: Mount Quidamortem, Kourend (team raid)

recommended.note: Or 85 melee — CoX wants both
Overheads through the rooms

presets.name: Ranged entry
presets.description: An entry ranged setup — CoX swaps styles per room, so treat this as the ranged half of a switch.

inventory.name: Melee switch
inventory.note: Whip + defender for Tekton and melee hand

presets.notes: Team raid — learn the rooms in a learner clan. Olm's head phase is the mechanic wall.

bosses.notes: Drops the Twisted bow, ancestral robes and the Olmlet pet. Team content — a learner-friendly raid.

bosses.name: Theatre of Blood
bosses.tagline: Raids 2 — the vampyric blood sport of Ver Sinhaza.
bosses.location: Ver Sinhaza, Morytania (team raid)

recommended.note: Melee is the spine of ToB
Tight prayer switching

presets.name: Melee entry
presets.description: Entry melee — the Scythe of Vitur is the endgame pick, but teams take whip/fang learners all day.
presets.notes: ToB is the hardest raid to learn — Verzik's phases punish mistakes. A Night at the Theatre quest is the solo easy-mode on-ramp.

bosses.notes: Drops the Scythe of Vitur, Avernic defender and Justiciar armour.

bosses.name: Tombs of Amascut
bosses.tagline: Raids 3 — solo-friendly with scaling invocations.
bosses.location: The Necropolis, Kharidian Desert

recommended.note: Fang territory — melee carries
Zebak and the ranged sections

presets.name: Melee entry
presets.description: Entry (150 invocation) melee — ToA scales from solo entry to team expert.

inventory.name: Ranged switch
inventory.note: Blowpipe or crossbow for Zebak

presets.notes: The invocation system scales difficulty — start at 0–150 and climb. It's the most solo-friendly raid.

bosses.notes: Drops the Osmumten's fang, Lightbearer and the Tumeken's shadow. Beneath Cursed Sands is the gate.

bosses.name: The Gauntlet
bosses.tagline: The Song of the Elves gauntlet — craft everything, bring nothing.
bosses.location: Prifddinas (Song of the Elves)

recommended.note: Or 85 Magic — pick one to craft toward
Protect from the Hunllef's style

presets.name: Crafted in-raid
presets.description: You enter with nothing — weapons, armour and food are all crafted inside from gathered materials. There is no loadout to wear.

inventory.name: Nothing
inventory.note: Every item is made inside from gathered resources

inventory.name: Crystal bow / staff
inventory.note: Craft one and armour it up before the Hunllef

inventory.name: Food
inventory.note: Cook paddlefish/egnoto inside for the fight

presets.notes: The regular Gauntlet is the trainer; the Corrupted Gauntlet is the profitable, time-pressured version. Prep speed is the real skill.

bosses.notes: Drops the enhanced crystal weapon seed (→ Bow of Faerdhinen / blade of Saeldor). No gear to import — the whole point is crafting under time pressure.
